en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from one of his companions, from Abu Hafs Al Abbar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘it is upon you with (eating) the lettuce, for it cleans the blood’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘ Abd Allah from his father from certain persons of his people from abu Hafs ibn al-Abbar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must eat lettuce because it cleanses blood.’”
